verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon), and operating a chip through natural-language commands is a category error; that interaction belongs to the OS or apps running on it. The Copilot+ PC positioning and the AI Hub/GenieX model tooling are host-platform features and developer building blocks for on-device AI. None of it shows the chip itself accepting natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
